Hello Simon:

I hope all is well, and Happy Chinese New Year to you and yours!

We do not have a chip preference.  However, whichever chip is used must be robust and powerful enough to support stacking technology from both a hardware and software perspective.  For the hardware side, the switches will need to support 10/100/1G/10G copper and SFP Ethernet, as well as dedicated high-speed stacking modules (40/80/100G).  For the software side, all stacked switches must be recognized as one logical switch with virtualization management.

Are you able to develop such switches?

Thank you,

text:
Dear s.sagatelecom

In this month’s newsletter, we introduce IAI's ROBOPUMP Airless Vacuum Pump. Airless vacuum pumps simplify installation by eliminating air piping, compressors, and solenoid valves. Connect directly to power, save space, and reduce setup time — perfect for tight industrial spaces.

Our January newsletter also includes a blog that will be of interest to our aviation customers. It discusses how you can seamlessly transition to certified fuel filtration with Parker's drop-in CDFX™ Solution for EI 1583 phase-out.

Want to learn more about Z Focusing? In automation applications, Z focusing refers to the precise control of vertical positioning (along the Z-axis) to maintain accurate focus during processes like imaging, inspection, or metrology. This article discusses techniques used to enhance Z Focusing and tips on selecting the right Z Focus solution.

Also, be sure to check out the ACS Motion Control EtherCAT® Dual & Single Axis NanoPWM™ Drive Module, NPMpm. The NPMPpm is a line of the most advanced PWM servo drives available today.
